column1: # Curated unit surfaces for English: hand-rolled, where ICU and CLDR have nothing.
# "surface" rows: a unit surface English writes that ICU writes in no English locale,
# mapped to the ICU unit it names. Only the mapping is curated: the unit, the value,
# and every expansion ("cubic centimeters") are ICU's. Each was measured in the
# "compose" rows: units ICU composes (an SI prefix, a product, a quotient) that are
# worth building. ICU composes any prefix onto any unit, and some compositions are false
# readings (its centicentury is written "cc", its decibyte "dB"), so which to build is a
# "currency" rows: a currency surface the currency reader does not take from ICU,
# mapped to an ISO 4217 code; the currency's names stay ICU's.
